mapper.select: SELECT TRANSFER_ID as transferId, TRANSFER_NO as transferNo, TRANSFER_PERIOD as transferPeriod, TRANSFER_TYPE as transferType, TRANSFER_TYPE_NAME as transferTypeName, INVENTORY_COUNT as inventoryCount, TRANSFER_AMOUNT as transferAmount, VARIANCE_AMOUNT as varianceAmount, TRANSFER_STATUS as transferStatus, VOUCHER_COUNT as voucherCount, VOUCHER_IDS as voucherIds, TO_CHAR(TRANSFER_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as transferTime, DESCRIPTION as description, CREATOR_ID as creatorId, TO_CHAR(CREATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as createTime FROM TBL_COST_TRANSFER WHERE TRANSFER_ID = #{param.transferId} AND TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} AND DELETED = 0
